caveat: Heuristic search over finite orders: falsification evidence only; it proves nothing about all forests.

definitions.TAIL: p[r] >= p[r+1] for L <= r <= alpha-1
definitions.WR_r: p[r-1] <= r*p[r] for 1 <= r <= L-1; ratio w_r = p[r-1]/(r*p[r])
definitions.min_margin_r3plus: min over 3 <= r <= L-1 of m_r
definitions.orders: trees/forests of orders 20..300 (trend phase additionally uses 320 and 640)

local_search.moves: leaf prune-regraft (uniform / degree-preferential target), small-subtree (<=8 vertices) prune-regraft, internal-edge contraction, leaf-to-hub

objectives.iso_desc: minimise min m_r over descent indices 3<=r<=L-1 (p[r] <= p[r-1])

per_n_r_minima_format: per_n_r_minima[n][r] = [exact min margin m_r over trees of order n, float, witness_id into 'witnesses']

provenance.date_note: no timestamp by design; see git history for dates

analytic_limit_balanced.statement: for a = b -> infinity and k = 3, m_r -> 1 + (3 - r)/2^(r-1); at r = 4 (and r = 5) the limit is 7/8 = 0.875

double_broom_r4_trend.family: double_broom(a, 3, b), min over all splits a + b = n - 3

n20_exhaustive_check.note_on_m4_hint: the hint for the m_4 argmin was uncertain (a=10?,k=3,b=9 would have order 22); the minimum is recomputed exhaustively here and its argmin identified by canonical form

star_r2_margin_reference.note: m_2(K_{1,n-1}) = 2/n + 2n/((n-1)(n-2)) -> 0 is proved positive; r=2 is excluded from the adversarial objective

title: Heuristic adversarial search for negative/small ISO margins, WR/TAIL failures and non-unimodality (trees and forests, orders 20..300)
witnesses_format: witness_id -> {n, family, label, edges (list of [u, v]; null only for label-reconstructible structured trees beyond the edge cap), poly (extremal records only)}
